title: Inclusive P-wave Quarkonium Decay Widths from Lattice QCD and pNRQCD
summary: Inclusive hadronic decay widths remain a long-standing challenge for first-principles QCD. We present a framework combining lattice QCD with strongly-coupled potential nonrelativistic QCD (pNRQCD) to compute inclusive P-wave heavy quarkonium decays to light hadrons.
